nvitk.db.settings_paths
=======================

.. py:module:: nvitk.db.settings_paths

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Locate ``.nvitk/settings.json`` and read the ``db`` block.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.db.settings_paths._find_repo_root
   nvitk.db.settings_paths.settings_json_path
   nvitk.db.settings_paths.load_db_settings_block
   nvitk.db.settings_paths.configured_sge_dataset_root
   nvitk.db.settings_paths.sge_dataset_root_path


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _find_repo_root() -> pathlib.Path | None

   Walk up from this file to find the repo root (the ancestor with ``pyproject.toml`` and
   ``src/nvitk/``); ``None`` if not found (e.g. an installed, non-editable package).


.. py:function:: settings_json_path() -> pathlib.Path | None

   Return the first existing ``.nvitk/settings.json`` on the search path.


.. py:function:: load_db_settings_block() -> dict[str, Any]

   Parse the ``db`` section from settings, or return ``{}``.


.. py:function:: configured_sge_dataset_root() -> pathlib.Path | None

   Return ``db.sge_root`` from settings (path may not exist on this host).


.. py:function:: sge_dataset_root_path(*, must_exist: bool = True) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Resolve the cluster dataset root from env or ``db.sge_root``.
